candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable, causing inventory /v1/reservations 503 and order ReadTimeout, propagating 502 to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; root cause of redis timeouts (load, saturation, network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failure correlates with redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory, cascading 503/ReadTimeout to order and 502 at gateway. Gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s with ~2.4s p95. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout; redis-side evidence still needed to confirm mechanism.
missing_evidence: Redis/inventory dependency metrics and logs showing timeout cause and error rates
Order service logs confirming downstream inventory/redis failure propagation
